fields.title: Instagram merchant profile record
fields.description: One row per public Instagram account: business profile, follower and engagement metrics, business contact details, and the bio links that are a merchant's actual storefront. NOTE: this actor does not return Instagram Shop products - that surface no longer exists publicly (see the actor README). `_source` records which strategy produced the row, because the richer fields (business contact/address, posts) come only from the JSON API. Every type is nullable accordingly.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The username this record belongs to.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-web-profile-info (richest: business contact + posts), S2-profile-html (page-embedded JSON: no business contact, no posts), S3-og-meta (degraded: rounded counts only), or none on failure.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this profile was scraped.

_warning.title: Warning
_warning.description: Non-fatal degradation marker. 'counts_are_rounded_og_values' means follower/post counts came from Instagram's og tags and are rounded (e.g. 680K), not exact.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failure rows (INVALID_INPUT, NOT_FOUND, BLOCKED_AFTER_RETRIES, UPSTREAM_SHAPE_CHANGED, EMPTY_RESULT).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

userId.title: User ID
userId.description: Instagram's numeric account ID as a string.

biography.title: Bio
biography.description: Profile bio text. For merchants this often carries store locations and ordering instructions.

isVerified.title: Verified
isVerified.description: Whether the account carries a verification badge.

isBusinessAccount.title: Business account
isBusinessAccount.description: Whether Instagram flags this as a business account. API strategy only.

isProfessionalAccount.title: Professional account
isProfessionalAccount.description: Business or creator account. API strategy only.

categoryName.title: Category
categoryName.description: Self-declared business category. API strategy only, and frequently null.

followers.title: Followers
followers.description: Follower count. Exact from the API/HTML strategies; rounded when _warning says so.

profilePicUrl.title: Profile picture
profilePicUrl.description: Profile image URL. Instagram CDN links are signed and expire.

businessEmail.title: Business email
businessEmail.description: Public business email where the account publishes one. API strategy only.

businessPhone.title: Business phone
businessPhone.description: Public business phone number. API strategy only.

businessContactMethod.title: Contact method
businessContactMethod.description: How the account prefers to be contacted, e.g. CALL, EMAIL, TEXT. API strategy only.

businessCity.title: Business city
businessCity.description: City from the account's business address. API strategy only.

businessStreet.title: Business street
businessStreet.description: Street address where published. API strategy only.

businessZip.title: Business postcode
businessZip.description: Postcode where published. API strategy only.

businessLatitude.title: Latitude
businessLatitude.description: Latitude of the business address. API strategy only.

businessLongitude.title: Longitude
businessLongitude.description: Longitude of the business address. API strategy only.

bioLinks.title: Bio links
bioLinks.description: The links in the profile bio, each with url, title, linkType and a platform label. For a merchant this is the actual storefront - Instagram's l.instagram.com redirect wrapper is unwrapped to the real destination.

bioLinkCount.title: Bio link count
bioLinkCount.description: How many distinct bio links the profile publishes.

primaryShopLink.title: Primary shop link
primaryShopLink.description: The first bio link - in practice the merchant's main storefront or link aggregator.

linkPlatforms.title: Link platforms
linkPlatforms.description: Platform labels found across the bio links: SHOPEE, TOKOPEDIA, BLIBLI, LAZADA, TIKTOK, WHATSAPP, LINK_AGGREGATOR, SHOPIFY, OTHER, and so on.

marketplaces.title: Marketplaces
marketplaces.description: Just the marketplace platforms the merchant links to - where they actually sell.

sellsOnMarketplace.title: Sells on a marketplace
sellsOnMarketplace.description: True when at least one bio link points to a marketplace rather than only a website or aggregator.

hasWhatsApp.title: Has WhatsApp
hasWhatsApp.description: True when a bio link is a WhatsApp contact - the dominant order channel for many SEA merchants.

postsPerFollower.title: Posts per follower
postsPerFollower.description: Post count divided by followers - a crude posting-intensity measure.

avgEngagementPerPost.title: Avg engagement per post
avgEngagementPerPost.description: Mean likes + comments across the fetched recent posts. Null when posts were not fetched.

engagementRatePercent.title: Engagement rate %
engagementRatePercent.description: Average engagement per post as a percentage of followers, computed over the fetched posts only - a sample, not a lifetime average.

recentPosts.title: Recent posts
recentPosts.description: Recent posts with shortcode, url, caption, likes, comments, mediaUrl, videoUrl, mediaType and takenAt. Note `mediaType` is Instagram's media kind (feed/clips/igtv), not a shopping product type. Empty unless the API strategy succeeded and posts were requested.
